objective.statement: 99% of BACK GET /up probes succeed in any 1h window (36s error budget).

observabilityContract.because: demo compose healthcheck is an HTTP GET /up that records a process exit code. There is no Prometheus (or other) time series, no role/path/probe_id/status_class labels, no scrape target. /_cpcp/up is a JSON liveness document, not a ratio metric.

evaluate.because: remaining must be a fraction between 0 and 1

budgetGate.because: no observed error rate, so no burn, so no remaining fraction. The gate cannot decide. Do not treat absence of paging as a healthy budget.

burnRate.because: BurnRate.classify needs windowed burn factors. Nothing produces them.

runbook.when_it_fires: BACK /up is not 200. Do not docker commit. Do not reinstantiate an image onto the live mind-data volume and call it rollback.

restart_container.because: consequence is contained; log to the audit trail and proceed

activate_materialization.because: irreversible with a service blast radius

because: the Objective is a well-formed spec of a metric that is not emitted; ObservabilityContract.check_signal on the actual healthcheck is required_attribute_missing; BudgetGate.evaluate(remaining: nil) is remaining_invalid. Activation is blocked.
